purpose: Prove 20 structurally IDENTICAL questions stay 20 questions. Every control on the page shares one of two accessible names (Yes/No) and one role (radio); only group_key distinguishes them.
targeted_defect: None (regression guard) - the adversarial case for any dedupe-by-(role,name) logic anywhere between the walker and the manifest. A collapse here silently deletes 19 of the application's 20 questions while the crawl reports the form fully covered.

group_key_partition.why: 40 radios must partition into exactly 20 groups of 2. Anything else is a collapse or a shatter.

name_fingerprint_collapse.why: Records the adversarial property explicitly: the (role, name) fingerprint of the 40 radios takes only 2 distinct values, so name alone can never identify a control on this page.
